sections.Profile:
Bowling Queen , produced by D. Gottlieb & Co. in July 1964, is an electro-mechanical pinball machine designed by Wayne Neyens, with artwork by Roy Parker. It features a bowling theme, which was popular at the time, and utilizes mechanical backbox animation where bowling balls line up as part of the game's visual appeal.
